Name: Claude Sessions
Author: Alexander Salikov

Actions.Name: Claude Session
Actions.Tooltip: Shows a running Claude Code session. Press to jump to its iTerm2 tab.

Description: See and switch between your running Claude Code (CLI) sessions from the Stream Deck. Each key shows one session (project name + live status: working / your turn / idle); press it to jump straight to that session's iTerm2 tab. A summary key aggregates how many sessions need attention. Includes a bundled 8-key profile for Stream Deck +, a Property Inspector showing connection status, and on-device colour-coded status bars. macOS + iTerm2 only; reads local processes only, sends nothing off-machine. Unofficial — not affiliated with Anthropic.
